    StartersCountry club Bloody Mary prawn cocktailKing prawns in a Bloody Mary cocktail sauce over shredded cosHow to make it600g cooked king prawns150g mayonnaise3 tbsp tomato sauce1 tbsp horseradish cream1 tsp Worcestershire saucehot sauce, a few drops1/2 tsp celery salt2 lemons1 baby cos lettuce1/2 tsp paprika4 celery sticksPeel the prawns, leaving the tails on.Mix the mayonnaise with the tomato sauce, horseradish, Worcestershire, hot sauce, celery salt and a squeeze of lemon.Shred the lettuce into glasses and spoon over some sauce.Hang the prawns around the rim, dust with paprika and serve with lemon wedges and a celery stick.Beach kiosk fish bites with lime aioliCrisp battered snapper bites with lime aioliHow to make it500g snapper fillets120g plain flour30g cornflour1 tsp baking powder220ml cold soda water1 L vegetable oil, for frying150g mayonnaise1 garlic clove, crushed1 lime1/2 tsp chilli flakessea salt, to tasteCut the snapper into bite-size pieces.Whisk the flour, cornflour, baking powder and soda water into a batter.Dip the fish and fry in the vegetable oil at 180°C until crisp and golden, working in batches. Drain.Mix the mayonnaise with the garlic and lime zest and juice.Sprinkle the fish with sea salt and chilli flakes and serve with the aioli.Clams casinoIt's all ball bearings these days.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsFletch's country club steak sandwichSeared rump, Swiss cheese, jammy onions, rocket and mustard mayoHow to make it3 onions, sliced30g butter1 tbsp brown sugar4 rump steaks4 slices of Swiss cheese4 Turkish rolls, halved4 tbsp mayonnaise2 tsp hot English mustard60g rocket2 tomatoes, slicedSlowly fry the onions in the butter and sugar until jammy.Bat the steaks to about 1cm thick, season and sear in a very hot pan.Lay the cheese on the steaks and cover briefly to melt.Toast the rolls. Mix the mayonnaise with the mustard.Build each roll with mayo, rocket, tomato, steak and onions. Make two each.Gail Stanwyk's country club Cobb saladGail at the club in her tennis whites, while Fletch puts lunch on the Underhills' tabHow to make it2 chicken breasts6 rashers of bacon4 eggs2 avocados250g cherry tomatoes100g blue cheese2 baby cos lettuces1 chives3 tbsp red wine vinegar1 tsp Dijon mustard80ml olive oilBoil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.Cook the chicken in a hot grill pan for 5 minutes a side, rest and dice. Fry the bacon until crisp and break up.Shake the vinegar, mustard, oil and salt in a jar.Chop the cos onto a platter and lay rows of chicken, bacon, chopped egg, avocado, halved tomatoes and crumbled blue cheese across the top.Scatter with chives and pour over the dressing at the table.SweetsCountry club hot fudge sundaesVanilla ice cream, hot fudge, salted peanuts, cream and a cherryHow to make it300ml thickened cream60g brown sugar30g butter120g dark chocolate, chopped60g salted peanuts1 L vanilla ice cream4 maraschino cherriesHeat some of the cream with the sugar and butter until bubbling.
